title: Verifier transition function
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols. The verifier transition function maps a verifier address state and a pair of Boolean input symbols to the state obtained by applying one address step using the verifier chunk associated with $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols
